statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of dizziness and giddiness
The symptoms are clinically consistent with hemodynamic instability secondary to nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency
Mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring (CPT 93229) was ordered
The service was ordered for continuous ambulatory assessment to evaluate the correlation between symptomatic episodes and underlying arrhythmias or hemodynamic changes
The diagnosis codes submitted were I34.0 and R42
The denial reason code is CO-197
The denial was based on lack of required precertification or authorization prior to the service date
